name: freeCodeCamp Project Feedback

sources.title: Forum category — currently titled 'I Built This'; active threads showcasing projects with feedback requests

requirements: Post must be a genuine project seeking feedback — the category is 'I Built This' (formerly project feedback); pure promotion/advertising violates community norms
Expect Discourse trust-level friction for brand-new accounts (link/image limits on first posts)
preparation: A working project (live demo URL or repo) to share
A feedback-oriented write-up: what you built, the stack, and specific questions for reviewers
An account created ahead of time to clear new-user restrictions
workflow: Register at forum.freecodecamp.org and complete any required email confirmation
Read the 'About the I Built This category' pinned post for current rules
Create a new topic in category c/project-feedback/409 ('I Built This')
Title it with what you built; body should ask for concrete feedback, include the live link/repo
Reply to commenters — engagement is part of the community norm
watchFor: New Discourse accounts are rate-limited and may be blocked from posting multiple links — post once, cleanly
Drive-by marketing posts get flagged/removed; frame as a feedback request
Batch claims link=nofollow — unverified, assume nofollow in a forum context
Moderators are active; the category slug still works but displays as 'I Built This'
countsAsLive: The topic is publicly visible under https://forum.freecodecamp.org/c/project-feedback/409 without a login
unknowns: Exact trust-level thresholds for posting links as a new user
Whether links in posts are nofollow
